description: Business Analyst für Weiterentwicklung & Kommunikation – Produkte / Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d) About the Company e.dialog Netz GmbH is dedicated to shaping the future of the energy industry by delivering innovative digital solutions and outstanding customer experiences. As part of the E.ON Group, the company supports digital transformation through modern technologies, collaborative teamwork, and continuous innovation. Employees benefit from flexible working models, comprehensive onboarding, and extensive opportunities for professional and personal development. About the Role The Business Analyst für Weiterentwicklung & Kommunikation – Produkte / Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d) is responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, managing product backlogs, supporting software development initiatives, and ensuring the successful delivery of digital products. This role collaborates closely with stakeholders and development teams, manages release activities, performs software testing, and helps drive continuous product improvements within an Agile environment. Location: Potsdam, Germany (Hybrid) Responsibilities Business Requirements & Analysis Identify, document, and prioritize new business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders. Analyze business needs, data structures, and customer feedback to support product development. Translate complex business processes into clear functional documentation. Evaluate business requirements to support software enhancement initiatives. Maintain accurate documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Recommend improvements that align with business objectives. Product Development & Software Communication Coordinate the handover of documented requirements to software development teams. Collaborate with developers to clarify business and functional requirements. Support communication between business stakeholders and technical teams. Ensure development activities align with documented business needs. Assist in delivering high-quality software solutions. Promote effective collaboration throughout the product development lifecycle. Product Backlog & Release Management Manage requirement changes throughout the project lifecycle. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog. Independently coordinate software release management activities. Monitor development progress and release readiness. Track relevant performance metrics where applicable. Support the successful deployment of product enhancements. Testing & Quality Assurance Test software enhancements and newly developed features. Identify defects and communicate required improvements to development teams. Validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements. Support continuous quality improvement initiatives. Document testing results and recommended corrective actions. Contribute to delivering reliable and user-focused software products. Agile Collaboration & Process Improvement Work within Scrum-based Agile development environments using Jira. Participate in Agile planning sessions and team collaboration activities. Support continuous improvement of business processes. Analyze operational workflows to improve efficiency. Foster effective communication across cross-functional teams. Contribute to digital transformation initiatives within the energy sector. Requirements Required Qualifications Commercial vocational qualification or specialized professional training with several years of relevant professional experience. Ability to quickly understand complex business processes and communicate them effectively. Knowledge of the energy industry and IT processes. Strong analytical and solution-oriented thinking skills. Excellent organizational and documentation abilities. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative. Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. Experience working within Scrum or Agile methodologies. Experience using Jira for project and backlog management. Preferred Qualifications Experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar business analysis role. Experience supporting software development projects. Knowledge of software release management processes. Experience monitoring business performance indicators. Experience contributing to digital transformation initiatives within the energy sector. Benefits Hybrid work model with home office flexibility. Flexible working hours. 39.5-hour work week. Collective agreement-based compensation. Company pension plan. Subsidized cafeteria meals. 29 days of annual leave. Additional paid leave on December 24 and December 31. Paid special leave. Comprehensive onboarding program. Professional development and continuing education support. Financial support for work-related academic studies. Corporate health management program. Team events and company-wide activities. Free parking. Public transportation subsidy (VBB ticket). JobRad bicycle leasing. Free accident insurance. Health promotion initiatives and preventive care programs. Employee discounts and E.ON Group benefits. Equal Opportunity Employer e.dialog Netz GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where diversity is valued. The company welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and believes that differences in experience, perspectives, abilities, age, gender, origin, and lifestyle contribute to a stronger and more innovative organization.

description: Product Manager - Office with Flex in Dublin, Ireland ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development. We are seeking a IT Product Manager to join our IT Business Partnering team. The role is Office Hybrid, 60% office-based in Dublin, Ireland. The IT Business Partner Group (BPG) serves as the strategic interface between ICON’s business units and IT to stimulate, surface, and shape business demand for ICON’s business assets and capabilities. The IT BPG is a connector, orchestrator, and navigator between IT and ICON’s business units and external customers throughout the product lifecycle. As IT Product Manager you will be defining, designing, and implementing one or more IT products or services for external and internal customers. You will be acting as the liaison between customers and the information technology department throughout the product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Include Partnering with business and technology partners throughout the product lifecycle including vision, requirements, deployment and optimisation. Participates in the development and implementation of strategy, systems, and process changes related to the product or service area(s). Collaborates across departments and functions to develop and implement high quality products and services that meet user community and stakeholder expectations. Ensures that products and services are supported by well-defined processes, robust training, demonstrations environments, and other collateral to maximise awareness, operational knowledge, and user adoption. Analyses competitive offerings and potential partner relationships to deliver superior products To be successful in the role, you will ideally have: Understanding of the systems, processes and product areas represented including industry and competitive offerings Strong knowledge of product lifecycle and /project methodologies Demonstrated track record of success implementing corporate programs, projects and systems Proven verbal, written and presentation skills to communicate with multiple levels of the organisation The ability to problem solve and report on success across multiple, simultaneous projects and priorities. The ability to envision and communicate system enhancements. What ICON Can Offer You Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent. In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family. Our Benefits Examples Include Various annual leave entitlements A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs. Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead. Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being. Life assurance Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others. Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers. At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
